proposal.explanation: Fixed CDC reset synchronization by implementing proper two-flop synchronizers for cross-domain resets using only the originally declared signals. input_rst_sync1/2 now synchronize output_rst into input_clk domain (clocked by input_clk, async reset output_rst). output_rst_sync1/2 synchronize input_rst into output_clk domain (clocked by output_clk, async reset input_rst). Combined resets (input_rst_combined = input_rst | output_rst_sync2, output_rst_combined = output_rst | input_rst_sync2) are used as asynchronous resets for all sequential logic in their respective domains. This ensures reset on either side flushes all pre-reset state (pointers, gray-code pointers, valid flags) across both clock domains, eliminating stale transfers. No new signals added; only logic inside always blocks changed.
